text_blocks.snippet: If you've been exposed to COVID-19, you should immediately start taking precautions to protect yourself and others, even if you don't have symptoms. This includes wearing a high-quality mask or respirator, avoiding crowded places where you can't wear a mask, and taking extra precautions around those more vulnerable to severe illness. You should also get tested at least 5 days after your last exposure and continue precautions for 10 days, even if you test negative.
